description: UPL - Malla Vial intermedia precisada. Bogotá D.C is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Planeación - SDP. Conformada por calles por las que circulan el componente flexible del sistema de transporte público y altos flujos de movilidad en las Unidades de Planeamiento Local, precisada durante la formulación de las UPL. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Planeación - SDP. Its tags are Bogotá DC, Decreto 555 de 2021, Formulación, Norma Urbana, POT. It offers 5 resource(s) in DXF, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
